> *“A concise quote that sums up this user’s attitude toward the product or their goals.”*

### 1. Identity & Context
* **Age/Occupation:** [e.g., 28, Journalist]
* **Experience Level:**[Novice / Average / Expert]
* **Frequency & Devices:** [e.g., Daily on desktop, rarely on mobile]
* **Context:** [e.g., High-stress environment, switching between many tabs]

### 2. The Goal Hierarchy
* **Be-Goals (Self-Image):**[Who do they want to be? e.g., "To be seen as a reliable professional"]
* **Do-Goals (Activities):**[What do they want to do? e.g., "Quickly copy structured data from web pages"]
* **Motor-Goals (Operations):** [How do they interact? e.g., "Relies heavily on touchscreens."]

### 3. Needs, Pain Points, & Mental Models
* **Core Needs:** [e.g., Speed, minimal clicks, offline capability]
* **Common Frustrations:** [e.g., Extensions that require a mouse to navigate, slow load times]
* **System Expectations:** [e.g., Expects settings to sync automatically across browser instances]
